title: Why doesn't the AC blow air immediately in heating mode?
desc: The unit performs a 'warm-up' operation to prevent blowing cold air. This can take 1–4 minutes, depending on the outdoor temperature.

title: What if the AC isn't cooling or heating effectively?
desc: Ensure that air filters are clean, air inlets and outlets are unobstructed, and that doors and windows are closed. Also, check that the temperature settings are appropriate.

title: Why does the fan continue running after heating stops?
desc: This is normal; the fan operates for 60–100 seconds to cool down the heater safely.

title: What causes an air-releasing sound from the unit?
desc: This sound occurs when the refrigerant flow direction changes, such as when the unit stops operating or during defrosting in heating mode.
